           RESPONSE TO APPLICANTS’ LIST OF INTERVENORS
       WHO DID NOT FILE TESTIMONY OR STATEMENT OF POSITION

TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:
        COMES NOW, MCP18 LLC and Nicole Segal to file this Response to
Applicants’ List of Intervenors Who Did Not File Testimony or Statement of Position
and in support thereof respectfully show:

                                       Introduction

        On May 15, 2026, Applicants filed a list of intervenors who allegedly did not file
direct testimony or a statement of position. MCP18 LLC and Nicole “Sega” were
included on that list.
         On May 19, 2026, Applicants filed a corrected list of intervenors who allegedly did
not file direct testimony or a statement of position. Nicole “Sega” was included on that
list.

                                        Argument

         MCP18 LLC is a sponsor of the Direct and Cross-Rebuttal testimonies of Brian C.
Andrews in Interchange Filing Nos. 4332 and 4987. MCP18 LLC thus qualifies as having
filed testimony in this proceeding and should not be stricken as an intervenor.


                                              1
          Intervenor Nicole Segal (“Sega” in Applicants’ filings) is associated with the
Save Our Salado (SOS) group and is listed on the group’s Joint Position Statement in
Interchange Item No. 4359. Ms. Segal thus qualifies as having filed a statement of position
in this proceeding and should not be stricken as an intervenor.

                                          Conclusion

       Intervenors MCP18 LLC and Nicole Segal should not have been included on the
Applicants’ lists of intervenors who did not file testimony or a statement of position and
should not be dismissed from this proceeding.

                                         Respectfully submitted,
